item.title: Call for Contributions – Global Africa Issue 14 Africa–Asia–Latin America: historical links, present-day agency, imagined futures
item.description: Global Africa is pleased to open submissions for its upcoming Issue 14, dedicated to exploring historical entanglements, contemporary mobilities, and future-oriented imaginaries across Africa, Asia, and Latin America.The full call is available in the attached document, including thematic guidelines, submission instructions, and the editorial schedule.📅 Submission deadline: December 18, 2025📩 Send manuscripts to: redaction@globalafricasciences.org
